job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is an Illinois Teachers’ Retirement System private equity consultant RFP, not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System investment consulting services RFP. Its submission deadline cannot support the deadline asked about.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES
All proposals must be received at the address designated below no later than 2:00 P.M. CDT on Wednesday, September 4, 2024.
